text: Show src/reference.ipynb sections 6–10. Numeric median imputation, categorical most-frequent imputation, one-hot encoding. Fit candidates only on train. Compare on validation and inspect overfit gap. Select threshold by minimizing 10*FN + FP using hypothetical teaching costs. Saved threshold 0.13. Keep forest unchanged rather than refitting on train+validation, then evaluate held-out test. Source: artifacts/machine_failure_metadata.json and notebook.

text: Proposed architecture, not an implemented capability in this repository. Assumption: the user supplies the current observation. The LLM receives the registered predict_machine_failure tool description and schema, decides to call it, and supplies structured arguments. The harness validates arguments and invokes deterministic inference code, reusing the consumer predict_event contract with the saved pipeline and metadata. The tool returns p_failure, prediction, threshold and notices; model version may be added by the harness. The LLM explains the result without inventing readings or changing the decision. The application attaches the original structured tool result directly so the raw output is not regenerated by the LLM. Invalid inputs or tool failures terminate with a clear error or request for clarification, with no invented prediction. DAG below represents one request, with separate LLM planning and explanation nodes rather than a loop. A later clarification starts a new request. Kafka is the preceding delivery demo and is not required for direct tool inference.
